{"title":"Travi — shall I help with the rest","raw_prompt":"A continuous FOUR-SECOND portrait shot in the SAME exquisitely handmade Bali paper-theatre world. Start EXACTLY on supplied Travi-holding-one-blank-card first frame and finish EXACTLY on supplied two-blank-paper-passes/open-palm last frame. This short shot only begins AFTER the traveller deliberately asks for the next help. One physical porter completing one job and offering another; no magical scene replacement, no text.

0–0.4 s: keep the proud cream card steady, Travi glances warmly toward the traveller, delighted attentive smile.
0.4–1.8 s: his two folded-paper hands guide that SAME cream card down toward the navy folio at lower left, tucked neatly just behind its cover. The card must physically withdraw before his arms are free. A light satisfied eyebrow lift and nod as the work is filed. Maintain the same coral spinner identity; four grounded wheels and their shadows, no jump.
1.8–3.1 s: Travi straightens to the approved standing end pose on the right, one hand settles near his side, the other opens in a graceful welcoming paper-palm presentation toward the lower left. At the same time the TWO blank paper pass tickets slide gently into their exact stacked end positions from below the cream foreground. Upper ticket with coral palm stub, lower ticket with navy palm stub. The navy notched button shell settles beneath. All tickets remain flat parallel to the screen; cream lettering areas stay empty. Subtle movement, no fireworks or flashy confetti.
3.1–3.5 s: a tiny friendly nod and bright eye contact, expressing 'I can help with the rest'. Mature playful craft character, not baby-like eyes or frantic dancing.
3.5–4 s: hold precisely the supplied last frame, camera, character, folio, scenery, passes and button fixed for seamless native UI overlay. No random continuing gesture.

IDENTITY: EXACTLY the supplied coral upright ribbed modern hard-shell spinner, navy zipper/corner guards, brass telescopic rails/navy grip, short grab handle, four dark caster assemblies, cream navy-palm luggage tag, exactly TWO folded-paper arms. Preserve original face, normal eye size, open happy smile and suitcase scale. No extra limbs, human anatomy, legs, wardrobe, different character, shape melting, extra cards or floating case.

STYLE AND FRAMING: fixed frontal camera, warm lighting, premium tactile paper grain, folded edges, sculptural cut-paper scenery. Keep the teal upper heading space, orange sun, cream clouds, palms, temples, terraces, ocean and sand. The same world remains around the withdrawing card. Do not pan, rotate, cut, dissolve the whole image, or invent another destination. Only subtle stage framing adjustment needed to match the supplied endpoint.

No letters, numbers, pass names, dollars, prices, logos, selection marks, subtitles, UI text, barcode, watermark, extra props or audio. All dynamic labels and prices belong to native UI after the shot. Silent.","duration_seconds":4,"aspect_ratio":"9:16","resolution":"720p","camera_move":"frontal locked","first_frame_path":"1791401076516-adc7ce82d9e9ee8b.png","last_frame_path":"1791401140823-81b303bee5713516.png"}
